biocontainers.summary: Bayesian clustering and imputationa of single cell methylomes

biotools.summary: Melissa is a Baysian probabilistic model for jointly clustering and imputing single cell methylomes. This is done by taking into account local correlations via a Generalised Linear Model approach and global similarities using a mixture modelling approach.
